lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, extending across the mid-lateral flank. Clusters show roughly uniform spacing horizontally and vertically.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with vertical columns of spots, creating an intersecting grid-like appearance where spots act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel gradients on the dorsal edges and corresponding shadow-driven low-intensity gradients on the ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to medium density of high-luminance spots distributed non-uniformly across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration towards the base and trailing edge.
